authors: L. G. Gray, X. Sun, K. B. MacAdam
title: Resonance measurements of d-f-g-h intervals in Rydberg states of sodium and a redetermination of the core polarizabilities
method: microwave resonance (single-photon d-f, rf-assisted two-photon d-g and three-photon d-h) with selective field ionization in a sodium beam; Stark-shift corrected
caveats: Three entries are calculated, not measured (bracketed; flagged in comment).
Residual stray field ~21 mV/cm: Stark corrections applied, but values are systematically lower than Sun 1994 by up to ~2 MHz for d-g/d-h.
Use sun1994 instead where both exist.
